visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoors, a man in his late 20s wearing a black sweatshirt with a geometric red and white pattern on the chest and light blue denim jeans walks briskly toward a large glass-fronted building. The sun is bright, casting shadows on the tiled pavement. Lush green bushes with small red flowers line the sidewalk. Large yellow text and white subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) He enters a bright, minimalist Tesla showroom with white walls and grey flooring. A sleek grey SUV is parked in the center. He turns to face the camera with an animated expression, gesturing with both hands. In the background, other cars and showroom displays are visible under bright studio lighting. (3) The camera zooms in for a close-up of the car's front hood and horizontal LED light bar. The man stands next to the vehicle, pointing his index finger at the continuous headlight strip. The 'Model Y' text is clearly visible on the lower front bumper plate. (4) Moving to the rear, the man demonstrates the red LED tail light. He waves his hands to indicate the 'diffuse' lighting effect. The Tesla wordmark 'T E S L A' is visible between the tail lights. The background shows large floor-to-ceiling windows looking out onto a city street with cars. (5) The rear hatch is open, and the man stands beside the trunk holding a black foldable cargo cover. He points inside as the rear passenger seats fold down automatically via an electronic mechanism. His facial expression is one of impressed surprise. (6) He stands beside the rear of the car with his hands on his hips, speaking directly to the camera. Large text overlays '190萬起' and '250萬' flash on screen in yellow. He smiles and gestures with a 'shh' finger to his lips, concluding the segment in the brightly lit showroom.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 全新大改款的 Model Y 開箱. [Subtitle]: 老闆老闆我們現在要幹嘛. (2) [Subtitle]: 全世界賣最好的電動車 終於要在台灣上了. (3) [Subtitle]: 全新大改款的 Model Y. (4) [Subtitle]: 貫穿式頭燈 帥到不行啊. (5) [Subtitle]: 這個是跟Cybertruck一樣的一個設計風格. (6) [Subtitle]: 但可惜的是它有切啦 中間有切兩段 但是後面 這個就厲害囉. (7) [Subtitle]: 漫射式的後尾燈 它是由這邊發光然後往這裡打 再散射出來. (8) [Subtitle]: 那除了看起來很科幻之外呢 重點是它的光線比較柔. (9) [Subtitle]: 所以如果你今天是後車在看的話 你不會覺得這個煞車燈很刺眼. (10) [Subtitle]: 那這一代另外一個深得我心的點是 它有一個電動傾倒的後座. (11) [Variety]: *電動升降. [Subtitle]: 如果你家裡有小孩或是狗狗 放東西的話. (12) [Subtitle]: 直接就這樣倒下去了 然後也可以這樣再按升起來 自動升降 哇塞. (13) [Subtitle]: 那這台要多少錢啊 便宜 德國產的特斯拉. (14) [Slogan]: 190萬起. [Subtitle]: 190萬起 (你的便宜我買不起). (15) [Subtitle]: 然後這個如果是Long Range 再加選配選一選. (16) [Slogan]: 250萬. [Subtitle]: 250萬. (17) [Subtitle]: 全亞洲 只有台灣的特斯拉是德國製的 不愧是台灣 台灣人啊 有錢. (18) [Subtitle]: 我們是有實力不是有錢 欸 大家都說貴 但聽說 訂單很多 嗚嗚嗚.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with a brief moment of outdoor environmental ambiance, including soft footsteps on tiles. A male voice asks a question with high-arousal prosody. Immediately, high-tempo electronic background music enters with a driving synthesizer bassline and sharp percussion at approximately 128 BPM. (2) As the setting moves indoors, the ambiance shifts to a clean, quiet indoor room tone. The main speaker describes car features with a bright, professional, and excited vocal tone. The BGM remains steady in volume, providing a energetic foundation without masking the speech. (3) A vocal inflection shift occurs as the speaker reacts to the tail lights, increasing pitch variability. The electronic music's rhythmic structure syncs with the rapid visual cuts. The audio signal remains crisp with high spectral brightness and no technical distortion. (4) A mechanical whirring sound and a metallic click trigger a new phase as the trunk and seats operate. The speaker's voice contains a mix of narrative clarity and comedic 'wow' exclamations. The background music maintains its percussive beat strength throughout the demonstration. (5) The final phase features a dialogue exchange regarding price. The two male voices interact with fast speech rates and high emotional valence. The music reaches a harmonic crescendo before a final hard cut, maintaining a consistent professional studio-edited quality throughout.
